title: application-exception diagnostic report v3
description: A caught-object-report-json report object (corj/v0.12, https://github.com/dany-fedorov/caught-object-report-json) with the extension fields occurrence_id, context, and reporting_errors. corj definitions are embedded under $defs; a missing corj field holds its expected value, null means producing it failed.

corjBase.description: Base properties shared by the root and every child report, as defined by corj/v0.12.

truncated.description: Present when content or child reports were omitted to meet the report size limit.

instanceof_error.description: Result of `caught instanceof Error`. Omitted when true.

constructor_name.description: Result of `caught.constructor.name`; null when reading it threw. Omitted with as_string and message when the first stack line is `constructor_name: message`.

message.description: Result of `caught.message`; null when reading it threw. Omitted as described for constructor_name.

as_string.description: String form of the caught value (`String(caught)`); null when producing it threw. Omitted when it equals the first stack line.

as_json.description: JSON form of the caught value's enumerable properties, cut with [truncated] markers under the size limit; null when producing it threw. Omitted when {}.

stack.description: Result of `caught.stack` split into lines (or the raw string with stackFormat "string"); null when reading it threw.

children_omitted.description: Present when this node has child sources that were not reported.

children_sources.description: Root only. Properties children were collected from. Omitted when ["cause", "errors"].

id.description: Node id within this report: the discovery index. Not the occurrence id.

path.description: JSONPath from the root caught value, for example $.cause.errors[0].

level.description: Depth in the error tree; the root is 0.

child_ids.description: Ids of this node's direct children; a repeated object references its first id.

children.description: Every nested error found through children_sources, flattened breadth-first.

v.description: The corj report version. corj/v0.12-full marks a complete report, as produced by restoreExpectedValues or when corj could not omit expected values.

occurrence_id.description: The occurrence id: the typed exception's occurrenceId, or a generated AE_ id. Shared with the public report.

context.description: The context option normalized by corj's serializer with a 16,384-byte budget; null when it could not be serialized.

reporting_errors.description: Problems met while inspecting the caught value or the context, at most 8.
